meta.title: Jatin Bharmota | Data Analyst & Business Systems Analyst
meta.description: Jatin Bharmota — Data Analyst & Business Systems Analyst with 4+ years across aviation and IT. Predictive modeling, MIS reporting, SQL optimization, Power BI and enterprise system architecture.

profile.name: Jatin Bharmota
profile.headline: I turn messy operational data into decisions that move aircraft, revenue and teams.
profile.summary: Results-driven Data Analyst & Business Systems Analyst with 4+ years across aviation and IT — architecting enterprise platforms, building predictive models and shipping MIS dashboards that leadership actually uses.
profile.about: I sit at the intersection of data, systems and business. At Bird Group I govern a mission-critical aviation platform spanning 18 airport stations, translate strategy into technology, and build the analytics layer that tells us what is working. Before that I ran cloud environments for Expedia Group and taught the next generation of developers. I care about clean data models, fast queries and dashboards that answer the question before it is asked.
highlights: MIS / KPI reporting with Power BI, Tableau & Excel

process.title: Discover
process.description: Sit with operations, finance and leadership to pin down the decision behind the request and the KPIs that will measure it.

process.title: Engineer the data
process.description: Turn messy operational sources into clean, trusted tables with SQL pipelines, validation rules and documented definitions.

process.title: Analyse & model
process.description: Exploratory analysis, statistical testing and predictive models that explain what is happening and forecast what comes next.

process.title: Visualise
process.description: Dashboards and MIS reports designed for the person reading them: fast, focused and easy to drill into.

process.title: Ship & govern
process.description: Roll out to users, train teams and govern the platform through the SDLC so the insight keeps paying off after launch.

experience.company: Bird Group — Bird Flight Services India
highlights: Architected and govern a mission-critical aviation platform across 18 stations, cutting system downtime by ~30% through high-availability standards.
Own SDLC governance for 5+ concurrent modules with 100% regulatory compliance and on-time delivery.
Lead system & analytics integrations for 18 airport stations, improving operational reporting efficiency by 25%.

experience.company: Bird Group — Bird Worldwide Flight Services
highlights: Sole signing authority for ground-handling agreements across 18 major Indian airports with 20+ domestic and international carriers.
Mined airline & flight-record datasets for revenue opportunities, lifting ground-handling utilisation by 15%.
Ran large-scale MIS and analytics workflows, reducing processing time by 35% through automation.
Configured and launched application environments on AWS supporting 3+ production systems at 99.5% uptime.
Streamlined operational and QC workflows, reducing task turnaround time by 20%.
Applied analytical tooling to support project management and business outcomes.
Administered complete IT infrastructure — hardware, software and networking — for 100+ daily users.
Rolled out LMS and digital classrooms, raising student engagement scores by 30% over two years.
Analysed performance data across 5+ batches; structured reporting improved pass rates by 20%.

projects.title: Athman — Meditation & Wellness Platform
projects.description: Full-stack sanctuary for meditation and emotional wellness with bookings, payments, admin CMS and transactional email.
projects.details: Production Next.js app with NextAuth admin, MongoDB Atlas, Razorpay checkout with coupons and GST receipts, Resend emails, image uploads and a GSAP + Lenis motion layer. Deployed on Vercel.

projects.title: BFS Safety Incident Tracker
projects.description: Role-based safety incident platform for Bird Flight Services with SLA tracking, audit timeline and executive reporting.
projects.details: Next.js App Router + MongoDB with five roles (admin, safety head, investigator, duty manager, viewer), incident lifecycle with SLA warnings and breach alerts, notification centre, Excel import, PDF/Excel exports and AI-assisted summaries.

projects.title: Scheduled Flight Operations Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive ops dashboard for Bird Airport Services — KPIs, airline rankings, delay breakdowns and service ratings over a 3D backdrop.
projects.details: React + Recharts + React Three Fiber. Aggregates scheduled vs non-scheduled flights, top airlines, delay status and service-rating trends into a single operational view.

projects.title: Flight Reservation Information System
projects.description: Reservation system on a normalised relational schema — 35% faster queries through indexing and query design.
projects.details: Designed the ER model and normalised schema, tuned indexes and rewrote hot queries for a 35% latency reduction.

projects.title: Air Quality Index Analytics
projects.description: Multi-city analytics dashboard covering 10+ environmental metrics for trend discovery across regions.
projects.details: Python EDA pipeline feeding a Power BI model with city-level drill-downs, seasonal trends and pollutant correlations.

projects.title: This Portfolio + Admin CMS
projects.description: 3D portfolio with React Three Fiber and React Bits, plus a password-protected admin that commits content straight to GitHub.
projects.details: Vite + React 19, Tailwind 4, GSAP, Motion and R3F. Content lives in a single JSON file edited from /admin; saving commits to GitHub and Vercel redeploys automatically.
